title: Minimum Attendance Requirement
content: All students at CampusAI University must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in both theory classes and practical/laboratory sessions for each registered course. Attendance is recorded hourly by instructors. Failure to meet the 75% threshold in any course will result in the student being barred (debarred) from taking the semester-end examination for that specific course.

title: Attendance Shortage and Condonation Policy
content: Students having attendance between 65% and 74.9% due to genuine reasons (such as representing the university in events or sports) may apply for condonation of shortage. Condonation is granted up to a maximum of 10% shortage upon submission of a formal application and payment of a condonation fee of $50 per course, subject to the approval of the Dean of Academic Affairs. Students with attendance below 65% are not eligible for condonation and must repeat the course.

title: Medical Exemptions and Duty Leaves
content: Medical exemptions are considered for students who are hospitalized or suffer from serious illnesses. To claim a medical exemption, a student must submit an official medical certificate signed by a registered medical practitioner, along with laboratory/hospitalization reports, to the Head of Department (HOD) within 3 working days of returning to campus. Duty leaves for university-sanctioned events must be pre-approved by the department coordinator. The maximum combined waiver for medical and duty leave is 10% of total classes.

title: Attendance Calculation Method
content: Attendance percentage for a course is calculated using the following formula: (Number of classes attended by the student / Total number of classes actually conducted by the instructor) * 100. Mass bunks or canceled classes do not reduce the denominator if the class is officially scheduled. Students can track their real-time attendance percentage through the CampusAI student portal under the Academics tab.
